content.permissions: Guidelines may be translated or reproduced in any form without written permission from the ESC. Permission can be obtained upon submission of a written request to Oxford University Press (journals.permissions@oup.com).
content.disclaimer: The ESC Guidelines represent the views of the ESC and were produced after careful consideration of the scientific and medical knowledge and the evidence available at the time of their publication. The ESC is not responsible for contradictions or discrepancies with other official recommendations. Health professionals should use clinical judgment and consider individual patient circumstances and relevant public health recommendations. It is the health professional's responsibility to verify applicable rules and regulations relating to drugs and medical devices at the time of prescription.
content.declarations_of_interest: All experts involved in the development of these guidelines have submitted declarations of interest; these have been compiled in a report and simultaneously published in a supplementary document to the guidelines. The report is available on the ESC website (www.escardio.org/Guidelines).
content.supplementary_documents: See the European Heart Journal online for supplementary documents that include background information and evidence tables. Author Notes link provided.
content.citation: European Heart Journal, Volume 44, Issue 38, 7 October 2023, Pages 3720–3826.
